sources.entry: inklet - Turn your Mac trackpad into drawing board.

summary.name: Inklet
summary.one_liner: Inklet is a Mac app that turns the MacBook trackpad into a pen tablet, with pressure sensitivity on Pogo or Force Touch trackpads.
use_cases: Drawing or painting on a MacBook without a graphics tablet
Annotating PDFs with pen input on a laptop
Adjusting brush size or zoom with trackpad edge sliders
Presenting or drawing during video conferences
Sketching in Photoshop, Illustrator, or Affinity apps with a trackpad
summary.what_it_does: Inklet makes a MacBook trackpad emulate a pen tablet, so it works with any app that has built-in drawing tools. It runs in the background from a menu bar droplet icon and is started by clicking it or using a hotkey (default control+option+i). With a Pogo pen or a Force Touch trackpad, pressure controls stroke thickness, and light movement hovers the cursor without inking. Virtual sliders on the trackpad edge handle parameters like zoom and brush size, and palm rejection ignores accidental touches around the edges. The page lists compatible apps including Photoshop, Illustrator, Affinity, Pixelmator Pro, Sketch, GIMP, OneNote, Zoom, and Inkscape.
notable: Pressure sensitivity on Force Touch and Pogo trackpads, with finger drawing as a fallback
Virtual sliders on trackpad edge for zoom and brush size
Palm rejection for accidental edge touches
Works with any app that has drawing tools, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and Zoom
caveats: Pressure sensitivity requires a Pogo or Force Touch trackpad
Pogo pen is a separate accessory; without it, drawing uses finger mode
Page does not state price or current availability
